home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u: He Mea Hana no ka Hoʻomaopopo — ʻAʻole he Kumu no ka Hana ʻIno
home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-: Aia ma ka puʻuwai o Totem Astrology ka manaʻolana: manaʻolana no ka hoʻomaopopo ʻana iā ʻoe iho, manaʻolana no ka hoʻomaopopo maikaʻi ma waena o nā hoa a me nā ʻohana, a me ka manaʻolana aia kekahi poʻe i waho e kūpono iā ʻoe e like me kou ʻano.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim: Hāʻawi nā alakaʻi holoholona ʻehā iā mākou i kahi ʻōlelo like — kekahi mea abstract e hiki ai ke kuhikuhi i ka wā e paʻakikī ai ka wehewehe ʻana i ka mea e hana nei i loko. Ke hoʻāʻo nei kekahi Kekeko e hoʻopiʻi i ka Pipi hihiu i luna o ka lāʻau, hiki iā mākou ke kamaʻilio e pili ana i ka hakakā me ka ʻole o ka manaʻo pilikino. Hōʻailona nā holoholona i nā ʻano i loko a mākou e hana ai, a hoʻohui lākou iā mākou ma ka ʻōlelo aloha.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too: He mea hana kēia no ka hoʻomaopopo ʻana i kekahi i kekahi a me ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka lokomaikaʻi — ka lokomaikaʻi i hānau ʻia mai ka ʻike ʻana i ko mākou ʻokoʻa a me ka mahalo i nā ala like ʻole e neʻe ai nā kānaka ma ke ao. ʻAʻole ia he kumu no ka hana ʻino, a ʻaʻole ia he kumu e ʻae ai i ka hana ʻino a nā poʻe ʻē aʻe i ka wā e hana ʻia ai ka pōʻino. Ua manaʻo ʻia ʻo Totem Astrology e hoʻomālamalama, ʻaʻole e hoʻopaʻahao: aʻo mākou i ko mākou ʻokoʻa i hiki ai ke kū mai no mākou iho a no kekahi i kekahi me ka hoʻomanawanui nui aʻe, ʻaʻole ka liʻiliʻi o ke kuleana.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res: E lawe i ka mea e kani ai, e waiho i ka mea ʻaʻole — a mai hoʻohana i kēia mau alakaʻi e kumu ai i ka hana ʻino, ka mālama ʻole, a i ʻole ka noho ʻana ma kahi ʻaʻole palekana. Hiki i ka manaʻolana a me nā palena ke noho i loko o ka lumi like.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan: Ka ʻōlelo ma hope o kāu mau alakaʻi ʻehā — e ʻimi i kēlā me kēia papa, a laila e ʻike iā lākou a pau ma ka ʻaoʻao hoʻokahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-: ʻUhane, Noʻonoʻo, Naʻau, a me Kino — ʻehā hoa holoholona mai kāu makahiki, mahina, lā, a me hola hānau.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w: Wai, Lāʻau, Ahi, Honua, a me Metala — hoʻopaʻa kēlā me kēia māhele o kāu pou totem i kahi holoholona me kekahi o kēia mau ʻElima Mea, e hoʻohui ana i ke ʻano i kāu mau alakaʻi ʻUhane, Noʻonoʻo, Naʻau, a me Kino.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to: Lawe kēlā me kēia holoholona totem i ka polarity paʻa mai ka hoʻomaka — ʻIole lāʻau mau Yang, Pipi hihiu mau Yin, Tiger mau Yang, Pōpoki mau Yin, a pēlā aku.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co: Hoʻonohonoho nā waiwai kumu ʻehā i nā holoholona he ʻumikūmālua i nā huinakolu e wehewehe i ka mea a kēlā me kēia alakaʻi e mālama nui ai.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-: I loko o kēlā me kēia Huinakolu Waiwai, pāʻani nā holoholona ʻekolu i kekahi o nā Kuleana Kapu ʻekolu: ke ʻImi, ke Kahuna, a i ʻole ke Aliʻi — ʻekolu ala like ʻole e hōʻike ai i ka waiwai kumu o ia huinakolu.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl: He hoʻololi timezone maʻalahi i ka Manawa Nepal (NPT) ma mua o ka helu ʻana — he heleuma intuitive no ka heluhelu ʻana i nā kia lā a me hola.
home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan: He Kipi i ke ʻAno a mākou e Hoʻomaopopo ai i kā mākou Pilina me nā Poʻe ʻĒ aʻe a me nā ʻAoʻao Hakakā Like ʻOle o loko o mākou

home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and: E hālāwai me kāu mau alakaʻi totem ʻehā a e ʻike i nā kālena i loko āu i hānau ʻia e kaʻana like.

home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem: E koho komo me kāu mau holoholona totem ʻehā a e nānā i nā poʻe ʻē aʻe ma ka database lehulehu — i hoʻopaʻa ʻia e nā pilina Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, a i ʻole Mirror.
home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g: E ʻike i kāu mau alakaʻi holoholona totem ʻehā me ka manuahi — ʻUhane, Noʻonoʻo, Naʻau, a me Kino — mai kāu lā, manawa, a me kūlanakauhale hānau.
home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com: Hahai kēlā me kēia kau i kahi kaʻina hana maʻalahi a ʻoluʻolu mai ka hoʻokaʻaʻike mua a hiki i ka hahai ʻana.
home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a: E koho i kahi lawelawe a e hoʻouna i kahi memo me kāu lā, manawa, a me wahi hānau inā loaʻa iā ʻoe.
home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book: E hōʻoia mākou i nā kikoʻī a e kākau i kahi kau wikiō i ka manawa e hana ai nou.
home.p.a-focused-conversational-reading-: He heluhelu kamaʻilio i kālele ʻia i kāu nīnau — i hoʻopaʻa ʻia nou e nānā hou.
